tender.title: Support for CEC Digital Products
tender.description:
We are seeking to procure expert technical support to maintain, develop and enhance the capabilities of our digital products and services.
For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: 
https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-London:-Educational-software-development-services./53Y927A793
To respond to this opportunity, please click here: 
https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/53Y927A793

procedure.features: This procurement will use a Competitive Flexible Procedure comprising a two-stage process with an optional third stage. Stage 1 will assess supplier capability and suitability through a PSQ and evaluated questions. Shortlisted suppliers will be invited to Stage 2 to submit detailed technical and commercial tenders. An optional Stage 3 presentation stage may be undertaken where closely ranked bids require further assessment. Award will be made to the supplier submitting the Most Advantageous Tender.

lots.title: Core Supplier
lots.description:
• Provide technical development capacity to further develop our existing digital products and services throughout the contract via issued Statements of Work (SoWs).  
• Provide development capacity for digital projects that extend existing products and services, or for the development of new products and services supporting careers leaders and the CEC’s networks, that support our users via Statements of Work (SoWs).  
• Support the hosting and operation of our products and services and provide third-line technical support.  
• Manage our AWS infrastructure to ensure that our data, products and services remain stable, scalable and secure in the face of current and emerging threats.  
• Work collaboratively with the CEC to make effective and responsible use of AI tools to improve the efficiency, quality and pace of the development process.

renewal.description: The contract will be awarded for an initial term of three (3) years commencing in September 2027. The contracting authority reserves the right to extend the contract for a further period or periods of up to twenty-four (24) months in total.

lots.title: Learning Management System Supplier
lots.description:
•Provide technical development capacity to further develop our existing Learning Management System and related products and services throughout the contract. 
•Provide development capacity for digital projects that significantly extend the Learning Management System and related products and services, or for the development of new products and services supporting careers leaders and the CEC’s networks. 
•Support the hosting and operation of the Learning Management System and related products and provide third-line technical support. 
•Work collaboratively with the core supplier to host, operate and develop the LMS and related products and services.

renewal.description: The contract will be awarded for an initial term of three (3) years commencing on 1 September 2027. The contracting authority reserves the right to extend the contract by up to a further twenty-four (24) months, in one or more periods.

releases.description:
This is a Provider Selection Regime (PSR) intention to award notice. The awarding of this contract is subject to the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. For the avoidance of doubt, the provisions of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015 do not apply to this award. The standstill period begins on the day after the publication of this notice. Representations by providers must be made to decision makers before midnight at the end of the 8th working day, 14 October 2026.

For avoidance of doubt, please note that Section V.2.1.1 of this Notice (Conclusion date), this date reflects the commencement of the standstill period. This contract has not yet formally been awarded; this Notice serves as an intention to award under the PSR.

tender.title: Infant Feeding Peer Support Service
tender.description:
This is an intention to award notice pursuant to The Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023 (the 'Regulations'), in accordance with Regulation 9, under Direct Award Process C. Therefore, the notice sets out the contracting authority's intention to directly award a contract to the existing provider up to 29.5 months for its provision for a Infant Feeding Peer Support Service, subject to completion of the 8 working day standstill period.

This requirement has been procured in line with said Regulations, following due diligence which has included an evaluation under the requisite Basic Selection Criteria and Key Criteria.

lots.description: As part of London Borough of Enfield Start for Life Programme, the service provides breastfeeding support delivered across a range of settings, including but not limited to in the family home, across Enfield’s five Family Hubs and in additional community venues. This provision promotes the increase of breastfeeding initiation and continuation rates across the London borough of Enfield, with a particular focus on reducing inequalities in outcomes. Additional information: The existing provider is satisfying the original contract and will likely satisfy the proposed contract to a sufficient standard.
